snippet.title: CREWED | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CREWED is a cooperative multiplayer game where 2–6 players crew a barely-functional spaceship, taking missions from an evil corporation while desperately keeping their vessel from falling apart. Systems fail, chaos cascades, and the crew must coordinate - or die trying.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2662310/Crewed/
